Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Nebat_1: father of Jeroboam, an Ephraimite of Zeredah (1 Kings 11:26)
Rehoboam_1: son of Solomon who became king after him (1 Kings 11:43)
Abijam_1: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam (1 Kings 14:31) [Abijah in 2 Chronicles 12:16]
Maacah_3: mother of Abijam (1 Kings 15:2) and Asa (1 Kings 15:10), daughter of Uriel_2 of Gibeah (2 Chronicles 13:2)
Abishalom_1: father of Maacah the mother of Abijam (1 Kings 15:2)
Iddo_4: the seer who had visions concerning Jeroboam (2 Chronicles 9:29)
